{{Quote|Just get to the ''Falcon''{{'s}} hangar&mdash;we'll figure out what to do from there!|Han Solo, to Chewbacca|<ref name="HollowMoon" />}}
'''Simbarc''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Cadma sector/Legends|Cadma sector]]. It had both rich [[Ore/Legends|ore]] deposits as well as several famous [[Casino/Legends|casinos]], at one of which around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was caught [[Gambling/Legends|cheating]]. The casino's [[Security guard/Legends|security]] team pursued Solo and his partner, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], in a [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeder]] chase that ended with the two smugglers ultimately escaping to the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] where their [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|starship]] waited for them.

There, however, the pair was captured by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sollima]], whom they owed a debt to. The [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] then forced Solo to partner up with his acquaintance [[Billal Batross]] on a [[Mission to Moog Mot VI|mission]] to retrieve a [[Sollima's chief accounting droid|droid]] of Sollima's from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] world [[Moog Mot VI]]. In the meantime, Sollima transported the [[Prisoner/Legends|captive]] Chewbacca to the [[Hollow Moon]] [[Sollima's gambling network|gambling]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in order to make him participate in [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] fights.

==Description==
Simbarc was a terrestrial [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="HollowMoon" /> located in the [[Simbarc system/Legends|Simbarc system]], a part of the [[Cadma sector/Legends|Cadma sector]]<ref name="EAOC Simbarc" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA Simbarc" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="HollowMoon" /> It was situated on the [[Cadma Conduit]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[Dagelin Minor system/Legends|Dagelin Minor system]] as well as the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]] in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and the [[Junkfort system]]<ref name="TEA Simbarc" /> of the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

The planet had rich deposits of [[Ore/Legends|ore]], and its treacherous surface featured high pillars of rock that were connected to each other via elevated roads for both [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] and pedestrian use. The climate on Simbarc was [[Temperature/Legends|cool]] enough to make at least two [[Human/Legends|Humans]] visiting the planet wear warm [[parka]]s.<ref name="HollowMoon" />

==History==
===Cheating on a casino world===
{{Quote|How 'bout ''I'' drive next time, ''huh''?|Han Solo, to Chewbacca|<ref name="HollowMoon" />}}
[[File:Pursuit-HollowMoon.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The security team of a Simbarc casino pursuing Han Solo and Chewbacca in a speeder chase]]
In approximately [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="1BBYStradley">{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?p=222830&sid=634e9537b4a0efac4e276071c9f94f27|thread=SW Adventures - Han Solo and the Hollow Moon...|user=[[Randy Stradley]]|PTtime=[[March 25]], [[2009]], 12:29|quote=The script said two years before, but [[Leland Chee|Chee]] said to place it at one year before. Unfortunately, the script didn't get changed.}} &mdash; [[Randy Stradley]]'s comments on the discrepancy of ''[[Star Wars Adventures: Han Solo and the Hollow Moon of Khorya]]'' dating its events to both approximately [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]</ref> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] visited Simbarc's [[Dakata spaceport]], where Solo [[Gambling/Legends|cheated]] at the [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tables at the local [[Casino/Legends|casino]] in order to pay back the debt the pair owed to the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sollima]]. The cheating Solo, however, was caught by the casino's [[Security guard/Legends|security]] team, after which Solo and Chewbacca escaped on a landspeeder while the security team gave chase aboard an [[Atmosphere/Legends|airborne]] [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]].<ref name="HollowMoon" />

Solo attempted to fend off the pursuers with his [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] while one of the security guards, tethered to the team's vehicle, jumped onto the smugglers' [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]]. The chase ended, however, when Chewbacca drove the landspeeder off the edge of the pillar they were traveling on, causing the vehicle to crash into a lower rocky platform. As the security team then opened fire with their [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], Solo and Chewbacca&mdash;who were in the middle of an argument over the amount of trouble their escapades had been bringing them&mdash;were forced to run back to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] where their [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], had been landed in.<ref name="HollowMoon" />

===Captured by a crime lord===
{{Quote|Normally this is where my guards would be twisting your heads off&hellip; but you've caught me in a bind. I need you to do a job for me.|Sollima, to Solo and Chewbacca|<ref name="HollowMoon" />}}
[[File:FalconDepartSimbarc-HollowMoon.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' (left) and Sollima's starship (right) departing from Simbarc]]
Sollima and his underlings, however, were already waiting for the pair at the hangar and subsequently captured them and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] Solo. Sollima then forced Solo to perform a job for him&mdash;the smuggler was to [[Mission to Moog Mot VI|travel]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Bank/Legends|banking]] world [[Moog Mot VI]]<ref name="HollowMoon" /> in the Tharin sector<ref name="EAOC MoogMot">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Moog Mot system/Legends|Moog Mot system]]</ref> and retrieve the [[Sollima's chief accounting droid|accounting droid]] that the Empire had supposedly stolen from the crime lord&mdash;though in reality, it had been sold to the Empire by [[Billal Batross]], a former [[Thief/Legends|thieving]] partner of Solo's who had become similarly indebted to Sollima&mdash;and was keeping there.<ref name="HollowMoon" />

In addition, Sollima would keep Chewbacca hostage to ensure that the pair would not simply flee after being released&mdash;but since Solo still needed a [[Pilot/Legends|copilot]] for the mission, he was paired up with Batross. He and the released Solo then left Simbarc on their mission aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'' while Sollima and his entourage simultaneously departed aboard their own [[Starship/Legends|starship]], bringing Chewbacca along with them as a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]]. The ship then traveled to the [[Hollow Moon]], a<ref name="HollowMoon" /> [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="EAOC Khorya">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Khorya system/Legends|Khorya system]]</ref> [[Sollima's gambling network|gambling]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] run by Sollima, where the [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] planned to have Chewbacca fight in a series of [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] [[Death/Legends|death]] matches.<ref name="HollowMoon" />

==Inhabitants==
The security team of the Dakata spaceport's casino included [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]&ndash;speaking members of various [[Species/Legends|species]], including a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]].<ref name="HollowMoon" />

==Locations==
The surface of Simbarc was dotted with casinos that were famously "loose." The planet's Dakata spaceport contained one such casino.<ref name="HollowMoon" />

==Behind the scenes==
Simbarc first appeared in [[Star Wars Adventures: Han Solo and the Hollow Moon of Khorya|''Han Solo and the Hollow Moon of Khorya'']], the first entry in [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[Star Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] series of graphic novellas. ''Han Solo and the Hollow Moon of Khorya'' was written by [[Jeremy Barlow]], pencilled by [[Rick Lacy]],<ref name="HollowMoon" /> and published on [[April 29]], [[2009]].<ref name="HollowMoonDate">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/15-577/Star-Wars-Adventures-Volume-1-Han-Solo-and-the-Hollow-Moon-of-Khorya-TPB|text=Star Wars Adventures Volume 1: Han Solo and the Hollow Moon of Khorya TPB}}</ref> The [[August 18]], 2009<ref name="TEADate">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Simbarc [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square T-8.<ref name="TEA Simbarc" />
